testcase.name: the noun is inherited only when it is there and in a closed list, and the count says how many
an empanada de queso is an estimate of 180 g and a question and no cheese, no cheddar and no boliviana
yogur griego is the Greek yogurt row, with its pot and no question
una de queso after an empanada is another empanada
a dish of the protected lexicon is its own row or an estimate and a longer name is another dish
